name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: Billy Doe Meats drove a 5.36 ROAS on $1,494.11 Meta spend over 28 days, generating $8,009.23 in revenue from 39 purchases. The biggest movement is a 50% drop in purchases week-over-week, likely tied to the 6.96% spend pullback, though ROAS improved 31.61% suggesting the remaining spend is converting more efficiently.

performance.verdict: ROAS holding at 5.36x but purchase volume collapse is the real threat.

findings.text: 3-day purchase signal: 3 purchases Sep 14–16 vs 3 purchases Sep 11–13 — volume flat at near-zero; 28-day average is 1.4 purchases/day, last 3 days average 1.0.
50% purchase drop week-over-week with spend down only 6.96%; daily spend ~$60 is consistent but producing 0 purchases on Sep 14 and Sep 16 — revenue conversion is unreliable, not spend-starved.
SOW overdue Aug 31: Funnel test closed + UTM live (Ads — Meta) — open conversion test (code ihbp8pmtn8) has no confirmed close date; attribution gap continues.
SOW overdue Aug 14/Aug 31: Live-cooking event (Video/Content), Pre-launch gate (Admin), and Platform ownership audit (CRM) all unresolved — 3 blockers past due by 17+ days.
GBP actions dropped 48.45% week-over-week; last 3 series days show zero GBP actions (Sep 14–16) vs 14–27/day prior week — organic demand signal is weakening alongside paid.

suggestions.text: Close ihbp8pmtn8 funnel test and activate UTM tracking; purchases are unmeasurable without it.
suggestions.monday_update: The /halal-subscribe conversion test (code ihbp8pmtn8) has no confirmed close date and UTM tracking is not live — this is a SOW milestone that was due Aug 31. Without it, purchase attribution through Meta's 7-day-click window cannot be reconciled against Shopify, and the 50% purchase drop (7d) cannot be diagnosed as ads or funnel. Action: Khurram closes the test, confirms UTM parameters are firing on all purchase events, and reports result to Nacer. Success check: Windsor shows UTM-tagged purchases within 3 days of go-live, by Sep 20.

suggestions.text: Inject new real-footage creative into BWS - Sales - Muslims ($844.99 spend); purchase rate has collapsed despite stable spend.
suggestions.monday_update: BWS - Sales - Muslims has consumed $844.99 of the 28-day budget and is the dominant spend line, yet the last 3 days produced 1 purchase on $178.75 spend (~$178/purchase vs the 28-day average implied ROAS of 5.36x). Flat spend with collapsing purchases is the fatigue pattern documented from the test phase (frequency burnout). Action: pull one new real-facility or product creative from the Haney July 21 Drive folder and rotate into this campaign. Success check: purchase rate returns above 1.4/day over a 3-day window by Sep 24.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions recovery; if zero-action streak extends past Sep 20, escalate as organic demand drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 48.45% week-over-week and the last 3 series days (Sep 14–16) show zero logged actions, down from 14–47/day earlier in the series. This could be a data lag or a genuine local-demand softening coinciding with the paid purchase collapse. No action taken this cycle. Re-check Sep 20: if GBP actions remain at or near zero for 6 consecutive days, escalate as a cross-channel demand finding and consider GBP post activity or a local promotion to reactivate.
